card.name: Inside split drug and bacteria names
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a long drug or organism name, most often the 'pt' in Streptococcus. Also pieces inside names like linagliptin, venlafaxine and amphotericin.

modes.label: Streptococcus split
modes.description: The 'pt' piece inside Streptococcus when it is written out in infection warnings.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name, such as in a combination product title.

modes.label: Other anatomy words
modes.description: A middle piece of a rarer long word, such as an anatomy term.
